status: Predeclared before any wave 16 development result or final single-model timing
model_policy: Use the first subsequent complete policy that passes the primary development gate and its fixed second-seed mean gate. Assess the official outer test before timing; report its outcome prominently. A failed official assessment cannot support a claim that the accuracy target was reached.
seed_selection: Always the primary seed, never the seed with better quality or faster prediction. Keep the loaded single model's error separate from the two-seed mean.
tasks: All twelve preselected tasks, all three libraries; no task or model exclusions
resources: CPU 6, one native thread; all fits, solver jobs, builds, tests and other heavy study jobs must finish before the first timing pass and stay stopped until all passes finish
reference: Run check-only first. Freeze model, source, runtime, input and full-source/batch prediction identities. Require byte-exact outputs against saved quality predictions and XGBoost inplace-versus-DMatrix margins on every timed batch.
raw_scope: One shared frozen vocabulary normalization, one complete native model prediction and its fixed temperature exactly once
normalized_scope: Exclude only the shared vocabulary normalization; retain each library's own prediction preprocessing and fixed temperature
interpretation: Warm serving diagnostic on the frozen policy; model capacities differ. Do not reinterpret earlier model-set timings as paired speedups or claim an official leaderboard ranking.
